vulnerabilities.description:
Covert timing channel vulnerability in Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc. BC-JAVA core on all (core modules). This vulnerability is associated with program files FrodoEngine.Java.
This issue affects BC-JAVA: from 1.71 before 1.84.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase Secure does not use the affected Bouncy Castle Frodo post-quantum cryptography APIs.

analysis.detail: Bouncy Castle BC-JAVA FrodoEngine covert timing channel affects versions 1.71 before 1.84. Liquibase Secure distribution includes org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.78.1 (core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:1318), but grep for FrodoEngine, Frodo, org.bouncycastle.pqc, pqc.crypto.frodo, and BCPQC across Java sources returned no matches, so the vulnerable Frodo post-quantum cryptography code path is not reachable.

vulnerabilities.description:
Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm vulnerability in Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc. BC-JAVA bcprov on all (core modules).
This vulnerability is associated with program files G3413CTRBlockCipher.
This issue affects BC-JAVA: from 1.59 before 1.80.2, from 1.81 before 1.81.1, from 1.82 before 1.84.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase Secure does not use the affected Bouncy Castle GOST 28147 CTR mode cipher APIs.

ratings.justification: Liquibase Secure does not call the Bouncy Castle GOST 28147 CTR mode cipher classes or related GOST APIs required to reach this keystream reuse vulnerability, so the vulnerable path is not reachable from application code.

analysis.detail:
Remediated. This affected bcprov-jdk18on from 1.59 before 1.80.2, from 1.81 before 1.81.1, and from 1.82 before 1.84; Liquibase Secure now ships org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.85 via the managed bouncycastle.version pin in the root pom.xml, so the vulnerable code is not present in the distribution. The prior code-not-reachable analysis is retained below for the versions that shipped 1.78.1. [TECHOPS-1130]
Bouncy Castle BC-JAVA GOST 28147 CTR mode keystream reuse affects bcprov-jdk18on versions from 1.59 before 1.80.2, from 1.81 before 1.81.1, and from 1.82 before 1.84. Liquibase Secure distribution includes org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.78.1 (core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:1298), which is in the affected range. However, the vulnerable code path is not reachable from Liquibase code: focused greps across Java sources for G3413CTRBlockCipher, GOST28147, GOST, G3413, CTRBlockCipher, GOST28147Engine, and GOST28147ParameterSpec returned zero hits.

vulnerabilities.description: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.85, Lazy ASN.1 sequence forcing resets nesting-depth guard. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.12, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bc-fips 1.0.2.7 (1.0.X series), 2.0.2 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.3 (2.1.X series).
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase Secure does not call the standalone bcprov-jdk18on ASN.1 parsing classes required to reach this issue.

ratings.justification: Liquibase Secure does not import or call the standalone org.bouncycastle ASN.1 parsing classes associated with this flaw. The only Bouncy Castle references are Snowflake-shaded classes in a different package namespace used for private-key loading.

analysis.detail:
Remediated. This affected bcprov-jdk18on before 1.85; Liquibase Secure now ships org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.85 via the managed bouncycastle.version pin in the root pom.xml, so the vulnerable code is not present in the distribution. The prior code-not-reachable analysis is retained below for the versions that shipped 1.78.1. [TECHOPS-1130]
Bouncy Castle lazy ASN.1 sequence forcing resets nesting-depth guard affects bcprov-jdk18on before 1.85. Liquibase Secure distribution includes org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.78.1 (core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:1141), which is in the affected range. However, grep for direct `import org.bouncycastle.` usage across Java sources returned zero hits, and focused greps for LazyEncodedSequence, ASN1StreamParser, ASN1InputStream, BERSequenceParser, DLSequenceParser, and LazyConstructionEnumeration also returned zero hits. The only Bouncy Castle usage in production code is Snowflake private-key loading through the shaded `net.snowflake.client.jdbc.internal.org.bouncycastle.*` namespace in pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:7, pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:55, pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:57, and pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:73, which is a different package namespace than the standalone bcprov-jdk18on artifact reported by the scanner.

vulnerabilities.description: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.85, Name Constraints bypass via trailing dot in rfc822Name and URI. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.12, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bc-fips 1.0.2.7 (1.0.X series), 2.0.2 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.3 (2.1.X series).
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase Secure does not use the standalone bcprov-jdk18on certificate name-constraint validation APIs required to trigger this issue.

ratings.justification: Liquibase Secure does not import or call the standalone org.bouncycastle name-constraint validation classes associated with this flaw. The only Bouncy Castle references are Snowflake-shaded classes used for private-key loading, not certificate validation.

analysis.detail:
Remediated. This affected bcprov-jdk18on before 1.85; Liquibase Secure now ships org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.85 via the managed bouncycastle.version pin in the root pom.xml, so the vulnerable code is not present in the distribution. The prior code-not-reachable analysis is retained below for the versions that shipped 1.78.1. [TECHOPS-1130]
Bouncy Castle Name Constraints bypass via trailing dot in rfc822Name and URI affects bcprov-jdk18on before 1.85. Liquibase Secure distribution includes org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.78.1 (core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:1141), which is in the affected range. However, grep for direct `import org.bouncycastle.` usage across Java sources returned zero hits, and focused greps for NameConstraints, rfc822Name, GeneralSubtree, and PKIXNameConstraintValidator also returned zero hits. The only Bouncy Castle usage in production code is Snowflake private-key loading through the shaded `net.snowflake.client.jdbc.internal.org.bouncycastle.*` namespace in pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:7, pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:55, pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:57, and pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:73, which does not exercise certificate name-constraint validation or the standalone bcprov-jdk18on classes reported by the scanner.
